event.titlec: 心間盛筵—人間煙火映百味：《程師傅》
event.titlee: Food for Thought - A Cinematic Feast: "Master Cheng"
event.descc:
2019 | 彩色 | 114′ | DCP 導演：米卡郭利斯馬基 編劇：Hannu Oravisto 攝影：Jari Mutikainen 演員：朱栢康, Anna-Maija Tuokko 英語、芬蘭語及普通話對白，中英文字幕
2019 呂貝克北歐電影日觀眾票選獎
華籍大廚程師傅攜子遠赴芬蘭偏遠鄉村，尋人不遇，投宿無門。幸獲餐廳老闆西卡幫助，為他提供住處，他則走進她的餐廳廚房，以平生廚藝，令當地居民及旅客大快朵頤。可口鱸魚湯、馴鹿肉骨茶，他就地取材，以美食帶來愉悅，並且治癒身心。餐廳常客就教他享受正宗芬蘭浴，他在異鄉找到遠離塵囂的寧靜樂土，慢慢放下個人心結，迎接人生第二個春天。早在《金都》上映前，朱栢康已衝出國際，在本片擔當主角，演技初露鋒芒。由芬蘭名導雅基郭利斯馬基之兄長米卡執導，透過烹飪主題，佐以美好童話色彩，在芬蘭湖光山色中，烹調出一段跨文化的異國戀情。
event.desce:
2019 | Colour | 114′ | DCP Director: Mika Kaurismäki Screenwriter: Hannu Oravisto Cinematographer: Jari Mutikainen Cast: Chu Pak-hong, Anna-Maija Tuokko In English, Finnish and Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles
2019 Audience Prize, Lübeck Nordic Film Days
Professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote Finnish village looking for his friend but to no avail. Having nowhere to stay, Cheng is helped by the café owner Sirkka who offers him accommodation. In return he helps her in the kitchen surprising the locals and tourists with the delights of Chinese cuisine. He uses local ingredients to make delicious perch soup and reindeer bah-kut-teh, satisfying cravings, as well as healing body and soul. Café regulars reciprocate by introducing him to the joy of an authentic Finnish sauna. He finds a peaceful paradise in a foreign land away from the hustle and bustle, recovering from past traumas and rekindling passion. Before the release of My Prince Edward, actor Chu Pak-hong has already showcased his acting talent in the leading role of this foreign language film. Directed by Mika Kaurismäki (the elder brother of acclaimed Finnish director Aki Kaurismäki), with a feel-good fairy-tale ambience, Master Cheng serves a feast of cross-cultural love in scenic Finland through the theme of culinary art.

event.agelimite: For Persons Aged 18 or above Only
event.descc:
1985 | 日本 | 彩色 | 114′ | DCP 導演／編劇：伊丹十三 攝影：田村正毅 演員：山崎努、宮本信子、役所廣司 日語對白，中英文字幕
1987 美國國家評論協會傑出外語片
日本拉麵混合西部片元素，碰撞出意想不到的獨特味道。一開始就打破第四面牆，在戲院內架起餐桌，直接向觀眾提示觀影禮儀。寡婦蒲公英獨力經營亡夫留下的拉麵店，奈何廚藝不精，生意冷清，更有流氓滋擾。遇上頭戴牛仔帽見義勇為的貨車司機，見對方深諳美味之道，決定拜以為師，接受地獄式特訓，苦練出令人食指大動的真功夫。恰如《原野奇俠》拉麵版，伊丹十三不但着眼於拯救食店大作戰，更跨越電影類型，以萬花筒般的敘事結構，在主菜之外添上大量黑色幽默配料，不斷發揮狂想，透過極豐富支線，勾起原始欲望，諷刺世俗荒謬，笑盡社會百態。
event.desce:
1985 | Japan | Colour | 114′ | DCP Director／Screenwriter: Itami Juzo Cinematographer: Tamura Masaki Cast: Yamazaki Tsutomu, Miyamoto Nobuko, Yakusho Koji In Japanese with Chinese and English subtitles
1987 USA National Board of Review’s Top Foreign Films
When Japanese ramen meets Western film elements, an unexpectedly unique flavour is created. Breaking the fourth wall from the outset, tables are set up within the cinema itself, directly prompting audience film-watching etiquette. The widowed Tampopo single-handedly runs the ramen shop left by her late husband, yet her lack of culinary skill leads to poor business and even harassment from thugs. One day she encounters a truck driver in cowboy attire who stood up for her. Discovering his profound knowledge of flavour, Tampopo decides to apprentice under him, undergoing hellish training to master mouth-watering culinary skills. Much like a ramen-themed version of Shane, Itami Juzo focuses not merely on the mission to save the eatery, he employs a kaleidoscopic plot structure that transcends cinematic genres. Copiously seasoned with dark humour, the story is a torrent of whimsical ideas with richly layered subplots, stirring up desires, satirising absurdities, and mocking society’s foibles.

event.descc:
1995 | 彩色 | 100′ | DCP 導演：徐克 編劇：徐克、鄭忠泰、吳文輝、阮繼志 攝影：鮑德熹 演員：張國榮、袁詠儀、鍾鎮濤、趙文卓、羅家英 粵語及普通話對白，中英文字幕
設映後座談會 | 粵語主講 講者：文念中、張兆康 | 主持：陳志華
青年厭倦黑道生涯，打算改行揸鑊鏟移民他方，跑到滿漢樓拜師學藝，弄出笑話連篇。師承另一門派的大廚前來下戰書，一場關乎酒樓榮辱存亡的決鬥即將展開。為了提高勝算，青年與酒樓千金出盡法寶尋找退隱多時的廣州名廚出山襄助，豈料名廚終日酗酒失魂落魄，當務之急是幫他找回炮製滿漢全席的味覺與手藝。本是廚師鬥法的故事，徐克加入武俠元素及漫畫化風格，拍出別開生面的熱鬧喜劇。由尋常的乾炒牛河、咕嚕肉，到山珍海味稀世食材，盡情發揮想像，設計出目不暇給的烹飪場面。高手過招以菜式比試，煎炒煮炸重現刀光劍影。廚房，就是一個武林。
event.desce:
1995 | Colour | 100′ | DCP Director: Tsui Hark Screenwriters: Tsui Hark, Philip Cheng, Ng Man-fai, Yuen Kai-chi Cinematographer: Peter Pau Cast: Leslie Cheung, Anita Yuen, Kenny Bee, Vincent Zhao, Law Kar-ying In Cantonese and Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles
Post-screening seminar in Cantonese Speakers: Man Lim-chung, Cheung Siu-hong | Host: Ernest Chan
Tired of his life in the underworld, Sun resolves to reroute by becoming a chef and emigrating abroad. He seeks apprenticeship at the Qing Han Restaurant, where he causes a series of comical mishaps. One day, a chef trained under a rival culinary school arrived bearing a challenge, setting the stage for a duel that would determine the restaurant’s honour and very survival. To boost their odds, Sun and Qing Han Restaurant’s heiress pull out all the stops to track down a long-retired Guangzhou master chef for assistance. Yet the legendary chef spends his days drunk and disheveled, making it imperative to restore his palate and skills for crafting the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast. What begins as a tale of culinary rivalry transforms into a vibrant, unconventional comedy as director Tsui Hark infuses wuxia elements and comic aesthetics. From everyday dishes like beef chow fun, sweet and sour pork to rare delicacies from land and sea, the film unleashes boundless imagination, crafting dazzling culinary spectacles. Master chefs duel through culinary creations, where cooking techniques mimic blades in action – the kitchen is an epitome of the world of wushu.

event.descc:
1989 | 英國、法國 | 彩色 | 124′ | DCP 導演／編劇：彼得格連納韋 攝影：Sacha Vierny 演員：Richard Bohringer, Michael Gambon, Helen Mirren, Alan Howard 英語對白，中英文字幕
1990 芝加哥影評人協會獎最佳外語片
12月28日香港電影資料館場次設映後談 | 粵語主講 講者：陳廣隆
惡俗大盜貪得無厭，橫蠻霸道恃強凌弱，收購餐廳炫耀財富，以便縱情口腹之欲。缺乏愛的妻子芳心寂寞，默默注視書不離手的斯文紳士，廚房和廁所成了偷情勝地。這位情人坐擁書山，不但要填飽肚子，亦要充實心靈。法籍大廚將一切看在眼裏，一邊忙於炮製佳餚美食，一邊協助有情人找尋藏匿之所。彼得格連納韋以食物為引，用電影作畫，為各個場景空間巧妙安排不同色調，交織食慾與情慾，上演激情與復仇，以一場極致的視覺盛宴，挑戰觀眾感官。精心設計的餐廳既是愛恨情仇的舞台，同時隱喻社會權力結構，甚至是對戴卓爾時代造成貧富分化的尖銳回應。
event.desce:
1989 | UK, France | Colour | 124′ | DCP Director／Screenwriter: Peter Greenaway Cinematographer: Sacha Vierny Cast: Richard Bohringer, Michael Gambon, Helen Mirren, Alan Howard In English with Chinese and English subtitles
1990 Best Foreign Film, Annual Chicago Film Critics Awards
Post-screening talk in Cantonese on 28th December at Hong Kong Film Archive Speaker: Horace Chan
The vulgar tycoon, insatiable in his greed, bullies the weak with his brute force. He buys up a restaurant to flaunt his wealth, indulging his gluttonous appetite. His neglected wife, lonely and yearning, watches silently as the scholarly gentleman never puts down his books. The kitchen and washrooms become their secret dating places. This lover, surrounded by mountains of books, seeks not only to satisfy his stomach but also to nourish his soul. The French chef observes it all, busily crafting exquisite dishes while helping the lovers find hiding places. Director Peter Greenaway uses food as a conduit to paint with films. He masterfully arranges distinct colour palettes across each scene, interweaving appetite with lust, passion with vengeance. This ultimate visual feast challenges the audience’s senses. The meticulously designed restaurant serves as both a stage for love and hatred, and a metaphor for social power structures, even offering a sharp critique of the wealth inequality exacerbated by the Thatcher era.

2014 亞洲電影大獎最佳編劇、最佳男主角
設映後談 | 粵語主講 講者：王劍凡博士 | 主持：陳志華
印度孟買獨有的住家飯盒運送服務，已有超過一百年歷史，風雨不改，一向甚少失誤。然而一次陰差陽錯，造就美麗的誤會，一對素未謀面的男女因為誤送的午餐而開始互通書信，甚至成為知己。她是賢慧主婦，煮得一手好菜，偏偏丈夫不懂欣賞，婚姻漸變乏味。他是營營役役盡忠職守的公務員，喪偶後自覺再無生趣，退休在即更感孤單。本來是她為丈夫精心烹調挽救感情的午餐，卻意外送到陌生的他手中，喚醒他的味蕾，喚起他的希望。印度導演賴舒彼查以飯盒速遞系統連繫兩顆寂寞心靈，用食物打開心扉，在苦悶的都市生活中，發現令人感動的味道和溫度。
event.desce:
2013 | India | Colour | 105′ | DCP Director／Screenwriter: Ritesh Batra Cinematographer: Michael Simmonds Cast: Irrfan Khan, Nimrat Kaur, Nawazuddin Siddqui In Hindi and English with Chinese and English subtitles
2014 Best Screenplay and Best Actor, Asian Film Awards
Post-screening talk in Cantonese Speaker: Dr Wong Kim-fan | Host: Ernest Chan
The one and only, century-old home-cooking delivery service in Mumbai operates rain or shine. A fateful lunchbox mix-up brings together a man and a woman, who become pen pals and eventually confidants. She is a capable housewife and a good cook, but her husband fails to appreciate her talents, leaving their marriage growing stale; while he is a diligent and devoted civil servant, who is widowed and lonely as retirement approaches. She lovingly prepares a lunchbox for her husband to rekindle their spark, only to be accidentally delivered to the widower instead. But this beautiful mistake turns out to be a wakeup call – for his taste buds, and his hopeful heart. Indian director Ritesh Batra weaves together two lonely souls through a lunchbox delivery. Amidst the dreariness of mundane urban life, he uncovers flavours and warmth that touch everyone.

event.titlee: Food for Thought - A Cinematic Feast: "Toast"
event.descc:
2010 | 英國 | 彩色 | 96′ | 數碼檔案 導演：S.J.克拉克森 編劇：Lee Hall 攝影：Balazs Bolygo 演員：Helena Bonham Carter, Ken Stott, Victoria Hamilton, Freddie Highmore, Oscar Kennedy 英語對白，中英文字幕
著名廚師及美食作家史奈傑，不但獲頒大英帝國勳章，更被譽為英國國寶。他十多歲已顯露烹飪天分，卻有個廚藝欠佳的母親，她嫌惡新鮮食材，只愛罐頭蔬菜，煮壞了就以多士作晚餐。儘管如此，母愛無可替代，亦令他燃起自己煮食的欲望。母親離世後，廚藝精湛外表風騷的波特太太出現，激發起他要跟對方一較高下的決心，以爭奪父親的青睞。取材自史奈傑的回憶錄，導演克拉克森把那些私密的成長記憶，改編成充滿戲劇性的情節。食物為灰暗現實帶來色彩，多士是對亡母的思念，豬肉批是對同性產生好感的記憶，層次豐富的檸檬蛋白批甚至成了跟後母較勁的戰場。
event.desce:
2010 | UK | Colour | 96′ | Digital File Director: S. J. Clarkson Screenwriter: Lee Hall Cinematographer: Balazs Bolygo Cast: Helena Bonham Carter, Ken Stott, Victoria Hamilton, Freddie Highmore, Oscar Kennedy In English with Chinese and English subtitles
Nigel Slater, the renowned chef and food writer, was not only awarded the Order of the British Empire but also hailed as a British national treasure. His culinary talent became apparent in his teens, despite his mother being a poor cook who disdained fresh ingredients, but favouring tinned vegetables instead. When meals went wrong, she would simply serve toasts for supper. In spite of this, maternal love proved irreplaceable and ignited Nigel’s desire to cook for himself. After his mother’s passing, the arrival of the exquisitely skilled and alluring Mrs Potter spurred him to compete with her for his father’s affection and appetite. Adapted from Slater’s memoir, director Clarkson transforms these intimate childhood recollections into a drama. Food injects colours into bleak realities: toasts symbolise longing for his deceased mother, the pork pie evokes his first same-sex attraction, while the textured lemon meringue pie becomes the battleground in his rivalry with his stepmother.

event.titlec: 香港文化中心「樂器之王」- 管風琴教育系列2025 學員總結音樂會
event.titlee: HKCC "King of the Instruments" - Pipe Organ Education Series 2025 Students Finale Concert
event.agelimitc: 歡迎年滿六歲觀眾入場
event.agelimite: Children aged 6 and above are welcome
event.descc:
為推廣管風琴音樂及培育本地管風琴演藝人才，香港文化中心自1999年起每年均舉辦「樂器之王」管風琴教育系列課程，提供管風琴演奏入門訓練。本年度學員將於是次總結音樂會獻技，與觀眾分享學習成果。
主導師： 趙小玲
導師： 陳尚智、林芍彬、鄭莎、周敬敏
助教： 陳婷婷、葉慧欣、李燕萍、曾憲汶
表演學員： 林卓穎、羅上茗 覃梓陽、范滿森、殷朗賢 蔡承霖、劉巧瑜、孫安怡 何銘慧、馮淑媛、黃家寶
表演嘉賓： 曾憲汶、劉慧韻、黃穗
event.desce:
To promote organ music and to nurture local talents, Hong Kong Cultural Centre has been organising the "King of the Instruments" Pipe Organ Education Series every year since 1999 by providing fundamental training on the operation and performance skills of the organ. The students will share their fruitful achievement with the audiences in this finale concert.
Principal Instructor: Chiu Siu Ling
Instructors: Simon Chan, Anne Lam, Shirley Cheng, Philip Chow
Tutors: Chan Ting-ting, Winnie Yip, Sandy Li, Mandy Tsang
Performing Students: Lam Cheuk Wing, Law Emma Chum Chi Yeung, Fan Mun Sum, Yung Long Yin Choi Shing Lam, Lau Hau Yu, Suen On Yi Ho Ming Wai Teresa, Fung Suk Wun, Wong Kar Bo Pamela
Guest Performers: Mandy Tsang, Vivian Lau, Adrian Wong

event.titlec: 香港大會堂場地伙伴計劃 — 香港小交響樂團：《最愛小提琴》：孟德爾遜小提琴協奏曲
event.titlee: Hong Kong City Hall Venue Partnership Scheme — "Great Violin Concertos": Midori Plays Mendelssohn by Hong Kong Sinfonietta
event.progtimec: 音樂會全長: 音樂會約長2小時，包括15分鐘之中場休息
event.progtimee: Duration: Approximately 2 hours with a 15 min intermission
event.agelimitc: 年齡限制: 六歲 (此歲數以下恕不招待)
event.agelimite: Age Limit: 6 (Person below this age not admitted)
event.descc:
指揮 賴斯健 Daniel Raiskin 小提琴 宓多里 Midori
節目 蕭斯達高維契 升F小調第一諧謔曲，作品1
孟德爾遜 E小調小提琴協奏曲，作品64
柴可夫斯基 B小調第六交響曲，作品74，「悲愴」
闊別七年，殿堂級小提琴家宓多里再度來港與香港小交響樂團合作，聯同指揮賴斯健攜手演奏旋律優美，流暢動人的孟德爾遜小提琴協奏曲。宓多里之天后級演繹，勢必技驚四座！
宓多里是她同代的音樂家當中最受推崇的小提琴家之一。年僅11歲時便獲指揮大師梅達邀請與紐約愛樂樂團作首演，自此聲名鵲起。宓多里多年來為世界各地觀眾帶來頂尖的演出，多套唱片錄音獲評為典藏之選。她充滿氣度和情感的演奏，還有她不遺餘力地推動音樂教育的決心，使她獲廣泛尊敬及多項國際殊榮。
現同時為加拿大溫尼伯交響樂團音樂總監和楊納傑克愛樂樂團候任首席指揮及藝術總監的著名指揮賴斯健，亦將率領樂團演奏蕭斯達高維契早期的作品第一諧謔曲以及柴可夫斯基的第六交響曲，「悲愴」，帶出作曲家內心深處的音樂告白。
event.desce:
Conductor Daniel Raiskin Violin Midori
Programme Shostakovich Scherzo No 1 in F-sharp minor, Op 1
Mendelssohn Violin Concerto in E minor, Op 64
Tchaikovsky Symphony No 6 in B minor, Op 74, “Pathétique”
Debuting with Zubin Mehta and the New York Philharmonic at the age of 11, triumphing at Tanglewood under Leonard Bernstein after breaking two E strings in a legendary performance at the age of 14, Japanese-American violinist Midori needs no introduction. One of the greatest prodigies the world has ever seen, grown into a truly visionary artist with a marvellous career spanning more than four decades so far, Midori has worked with all top orchestras around the world, and is making a highly anticipated return to Hong Kong to work with Hong Kong Sinfonietta again, this time performing Mendelssohn’s exquisite Violin Concerto in E minor under the baton of Daniel Raiskin, Designated Chief Conductor and Artistic Director of the Janáček Philharmonic Orchestra. Tchaikovsky’s monumental Symphony No 6 and a young Shostakovich’s Scherzo complete what promises to be a breathtaking programme of exquisite masterpieces and extraordinary fireworks.

event.presenterorge: Hong Kong Sinfonietta

event.titlec: 香港大會堂場地伙伴計劃 — 香港小交響樂團：會說話的鼓
event.titlee: Hong Kong City Hall Venue Partnership Scheme — "Peter Eötvös: The Speaking Drums" by Hong Kong Sinfonietta
event.progtimec: 音樂會全長: 音樂會約長2小時，包括15分鐘之中場休息
event.progtimee: Duration: Approximately 2 hours with a 15 min intermission
event.agelimitc: 年齡限制: 六歲 (此歲數以下恕不招待)
event.agelimite: Age Limit: 6 (Person below this age not admitted)
event.descc:
音樂總監/指揮 柏鵬 Christoph Poppen 敲擊樂 貝特納絲卡 Marianna Bednarska
節目 羅西尼 《威廉．泰爾》序曲
艾特沃殊 《會說話的鼓》（2012/2013）
拉赫曼尼諾夫 E小調第二交響曲，作品27
波蘭敲擊樂超新星貝特納絲卡年紀輕輕，已在國際樂壇「擊」 出一片天，她獲獎無數，當中包括2019年日內瓦國際音樂大賽亞軍及特別獎，並曾在其他國際比賽中奪得24次冠軍殊榮。魅力四射的貝特納絲卡將首度訪港，與香港小交響樂團及音樂總監柏鵬攜手演繹匈牙利作曲大師艾特沃殊所寫的作品《會說話的鼓》。此作品充份顯現作曲家跨文化、跨媒介的探索精神，作品不但要求敲擊樂手具備極致的表現力，還要結合人聲，使各式各樣的鼓「說話」，強調語音的節奏與句子的鋪展，巧妙融合語言、詩意與音樂，創造出獨樹一幟的音樂篇章。
此外，樂團還會演奏活力充沛的羅西尼《威廉．泰爾》序曲和管弦色彩甚為豐富的拉赫曼尼諾夫的第二交響曲，帶來激盪心靈，張力十足的晚上。
event.desce:
Music Director/Conductor Christoph Poppen Percussion Marianna Bednarska
Programme Rossini William Tell Overture
Peter Eötvös Speaking Drums (2012/2013)
Rachmaninov Symphony No 2 in E minor, Op 27
Having enjoyed a meteoric rise on the international concert platform since winning 2nd Prize at the prestigious Geneva International Music Competition in 2019, Polish star percussionist Marianna Bednarska is bringing her electrifying performances to Hong Kong for the very first time. Joining hands with Hong Kong Sinfonietta and Music Director Christoph Poppen, she will present monumental composer Peter Eötvös’ Speaking Drums – an instantly captivating masterpiece utilising an impressive range of percussion instruments as well as the versatile human voice; the result is marvellous musical storytelling exploring the primal connection between music and speech. Rossini’s beloved William Tell Overture will start the concert, and Rachmaninov’s towering symphonic achievement – the sublime Symphony No 2 – will conclude the unmissable programme.
Marianna Bednarska (Percussion) “She dances elegantly through the percussion course and sets off a firework of rhythms and timbres.”
“She is not only an acrobat with her hands, but above all with her voice: magnificent, breathtaking, virtuosic.” Luzerner Zeitung
2nd Prize & Special Prize, Geneva International Music Competition 2019 Credit Suisse Award 2019 Grand Prix, International Music Competition ENKOR 2018 Has appeared at festivals such as Lucerne Festival, Tongyeong International Music Festival and has performed with orchestras such as Orchestre de la Suisse Romande, Komische Oper Orchestra, Poznań Philharmonic Orchestra, etc

event.progtimee: Duration: Approximately 2 hours with a 15 min intermission
event.agelimitc: 年齡限制: 六歲 (此歲數以下恕不招待)
event.agelimite: Age Limit: 6 (Person below this age not admitted)
event.descc:
小提琴 宓多里 Midori 鋼琴 喬庫芭維丘特 Ieva Jokubaviciute
節目 貝多芬 F大調第五鋼琴及小提琴奏鳴曲，作品24，「春」
舒伯特 C大調小提琴及鋼琴幻想曲，D934
浦朗克 小提琴及鋼琴奏鳴曲，FP119
克拉娜．舒曼 三首小提琴及鋼琴浪漫曲，作品22
舒曼 三首小提琴及鋼琴浪漫曲，作品94
舒伯特 B小調小提琴及鋼琴華麗迴旋曲，D895
宓多里自11歲起與紐約愛樂樂團首度演出，40多年來致力探索及推動音樂的善與美，譽滿樂壇。小提琴天后載譽回港，除了與香港小交響樂團攜手合作，還會舉行千載難逢的獨奏會，聯同她的室樂夥伴 ── 鋼琴家喬庫芭維丘特，展現一場小提琴與鋼琴的絕美對話！
演奏曲目精選自五位作曲家，橫跨德法音樂傳統，從貝多芬溫暖和煦的「春天」奏鳴曲到舒曼夫婦二人的浪漫曲，還有舒伯特和浦朗克情感層次豐富的樂曲，定必令樂迷沉醉其中。
event.desce:
Violin Midori Piano Ieva Jokubaviciute
Programme Beethoven Sonata for Piano & Violin No 5 in F, Op 24, “Spring”
Schubert Fantasie for Violin & Piano in C, D934
Poulenc Sonata for Violin & Piano, FP119
Clara Schumann Three Romances for Violin & Piano, Op 22
Schumann Three Romances for Violin & Piano, Op 94
Schubert Rondo Brillante in B minor for Violin & Piano, D895

event.titlec: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：香港中樂團 HKCO4U — 時空拾音 小品樂韻
event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: "HKCO4U – Echoes Through Time Chamber Concert” by Hong Kong Chinese Orchestra
event.descc: HKCO4U旨在匯聚樂團菁英，為年輕演奏家提供展示多元才華的平台。音樂會精選多首別具特色的小品，包括傳統古樂、絲竹樂以及融合爵士風格的作品，由中阮首席吳棨熙與胡琴演奏家黃正彥攜手演出，透過環保二胡的獨到音色與中阮的古典韻味相互碰撞，配合電子音樂與小樂隊的編制，既保留傳統精髓，又開拓當代表達。在這場音樂旅程中，無論您是中樂愛好者，或是初次接觸的觀眾，都能在悠揚旋律中找到共鳴。
event.desce: HKCO4U is a platform for exceptional young artists to curate works encompassing ancient traditions, silk-and-bamboo and jazz influences. Principal Zhongruan Ng Kai Hei and erhu player Wong Ching Yin helm this concert that merges their instruments, along with the Eco-Erhu, enhanced by electronic music and a small ensemble. This is a fusion that preserves traditional essence while exploring modern expressions, offering a musical journey filled with resonances.
event.presenterorgc: 香港中樂團

event.titlec: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：香港管弦樂團 安蘇菲．慕達的約翰．威廉斯
event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “Anne-Sophie Mutter Plays John Williams” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 2 小時 15 分鐘，包括一節中場休息
event.progtimee: Approximately 2 hours 15 minutes with an intermission
event.descc: 當小提琴巨星遇上電影音樂大師！安蘇菲．慕達將以精湛技藝演繹全約翰．威廉斯作品音樂會，讓古典音樂的磅礴氣勢與銀幕音樂的奇幻魅力交相輝映。從《星球大戰》的壯麗與奇幻到《哈利波特》的動人旋律，約翰．威廉斯的音樂在慕達的演繹下煥發異彩。曲目亮點並包括約翰．威廉斯為慕達度身譜寫的第二小提琴協奏曲──作品由慕達委約創作，展現她無與倫比的琴藝，為樂迷帶來令人屏息的一場音樂盛宴。
event.desce: A legendary virtuoso meets a cinematic maestro! Anne-Sophie Mutter brings her dazzling artistry to an all-John Williams programme, where classical grandeur intertwines with silver-screen magic. Experience the soaring adventures of Star Wars and the thrilling world of Harry Potter as Williams’s music takes on breathtaking new colours from Mutter’s violin. At the heart of the evening is his Violin Concerto no. 2 – a spellbinding piece commissioned and written specifically for Mutter. Join us for an unforgettable evening where the worlds of classical music and film collide in spectacular fashion!
event.presenterorgc: 香港管弦樂團
event.presenterorge: Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra

event.titlec: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：香港管弦樂團 中國人壽（海外）榮譽呈獻：新年音樂會｜哈布斯堡王朝的維也納
event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “China Life (Overseas) Proudly Sponsors: New Year Celebration | Vienna of the Habsburg Dynasty” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 1 小時 30 分鐘，包括一節中場休息
event.progtimee: Approximately 1 hour 30 minutes with an intermission
event.descc: 今年的港樂新年音樂會帶你重返哈布斯堡王朝期間歐洲的藝術首都：維也納，節目包括圓舞曲之王小約翰・史特勞斯的圓舞曲、進行曲與波爾卡，以及布拉姆斯熱情洋溢的匈牙利舞曲及李斯特瑰麗激昂的匈牙利狂想曲。指揮家馬達拉斯來自匈牙利，曾於布達佩斯學習作曲，並於維也納研習指揮，正是帶領觀眾踏上一場穿梭兩大音樂之都的完美人選。
event.desce: For this year’s New Year’s Gala, travel with us back to Vienna, Europe's centre of music, art and culture during the Austro-Hungarian Habsburg dynasty. The HK Phil performs waltzes, marches and polkas by the King of Waltz, Johann Strauss and family, alongside the ever-popular Hungarian Dances of Brahms and the brilliant Hungarian Rhapsodies by Liszt. Conductor Gergely Madaras, a native Hungarian who studied composition in Budapest and conducting in Vienna, will lead this jubilant musical journey between the two great capitals. With his unique connection to both traditions, he is the perfect guide for an evening of elegance, joy, and charm.
event.presenterorgc: 香港管弦樂團
event.presenterorge: Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra

event.titlec: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：香港管弦樂團 加蒂的馬勒七
event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “Daniele Gatti Conducts Mahler 7 ” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 80 分鐘，不設中場休息
event.descc:
馬勒 ︳E小調第七交響曲
加蒂大師回歸，再度演繹他拿手的馬勒！自2025年三月與港樂成功演出馬勒三後，他向難度進發，挑戰馬勒大膽創新的第七交響曲。馬勒七被公認為其中一首最難駕御的交響曲，樂曲透過意想不到的配器創造出璀璨迷人的色彩，糅合非傳統樂器（如次中音號、曼陀林琴與結他）與非一般的演奏技巧，讓樂團每個聲部都能大放異彩。豈容錯過的「夜之歌」！
event.desce:
MAHLER | Symphony no. 7 in E minor
Following his stunning success conducting Mahler’s Third Symphony in March 2025, acclaimed Maestro Daniele Gatti returns to lead the HK Phil in Mahler’s majestic Seventh Symphony. Often referred to as Mahler’s "Song of the Night," this symphony weaves an extravagant tapestry of orchestral colour, showcasing unconventional instruments like the tenor horn, mandolin and guitar, along with distinctive writing that gives each section of the orchestra its moment to shine.
event.presenterorgc: 香港管弦樂團
event.presenterorge: Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra

event.titlec: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：香港管弦樂團 艾斯的貝多芬協奏曲
event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “Emanuel Ax Plays Beethoven” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 1 小時 45 分鐘，包括一節中場休息
event.progtimee: Approximately 1 hour 45 minutes with an intermission
event.descc:
沙羅倫︳《開局》 貝多芬︳C小調第三鋼琴協奏曲，op. 37 布拉姆斯︳《悲歌》，op. 82 亨德密特︳《畫家馬蒂斯》交響曲
不屈意志遇上美麗心靈，發人深省的一夜。德國指揮新星萊因哈特將帶來「難忘的演出」（《音樂美國》），她首度來港指揮，並夥拍睽違港樂11載的鋼琴巨星艾斯！這位格林美獎七屆得主將透過貝多芬第三鋼琴協奏曲，帶領觀眾進入命途多舛的作曲家內心，聆聽其對希望的呼喊。同樣拒絕妥協，納粹德國時期作曲家亨特密爾大膽地將異見譜進壯麗的交響曲裡──獨特的聲音想必能引起當今世人的共鳴。同台演出的還有港樂合唱團，獻唱布拉姆斯對友人的真摯情感。
event.desce:
SALONEN | Gambit BEETHOVEN | Piano Concerto no. 3 in C minor, op. 37 BRAHMS | Nänie, op. 82 HINDEMITH | Symphony: Mathis der Maler
Experience an unforgettable evening with the HK Phil, conducted by rising star Ruth Reinhardt, who opens the concert with Esa-Pekka Salonen’s vibrant Gambit. Renowned pianist Emanuel Ax makes his long-awaited return to perform Beethoven’s powerful Third Piano Concerto, a masterpiece of emotional depth. The HK Phil Chorus then joins for Brahms’ poignant Nänie, a heartfelt tribute to friendship and loss. Finally, immerse yourself in Hindemith’s bold and dramatic Symphony: Mathis der Maler, composed during the turbulent years of Nazi Germany, yet still resonating powerfully with today’s audiences.
event.presenterorgc: 香港管弦樂團
event.presenterorge: Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra

event.titlec: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：香港管弦樂團 魔雪奇緣電影音樂會
event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “Frozen Live in Concert” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 2 小時，包括一節中場休息
event.descc:
與我們一起前往《魔雪奇緣》的北歐國度阿德爾，展開一場夢幻音樂之旅！《魔雪奇緣》動畫自2013年面世即風靡全球，這場管弦音樂會將以華麗繽紛的管弦樂音與色彩，讓愛莎、安娜、雪人小白及其他《魔雪奇緣》角色在舞台上活現觀眾眼前。從《冰心鎖》悠揚激昂的優美旋律到《你要雪人砌幾呎高》，這個節目定能讓觀眾有如親歷其境，走進《魔雪奇緣》每一幕扣人心弦的場景當中，共同感受角色們的情感，經歷奇幻動人的迪士尼冒險旅程。
電影原聲配樂由貝克創作，歌曲由姬絲汀．安德遜– 羅培茲與羅拔．羅培茲創作。
足本電影播放（英語對白，附中、英文字幕），配現場管弦樂演奏。電影屬第I級別。
event.desce:
Join us for a journey into the enchanting world of Arendelle! Immerse yourself in the lush sounds and vibrant orchestral colours that bring Elsa, Anna, Olaf, and your favourite Frozen characters to life. From the soaring melody of Let It Go to the playful Do You Want to Build a Snowman?, this magical programme captures the wonder and excitement of the Disney classic, enhanced by the heartwarming melodies you know and love performed live by the HK Phil!
Original Score of the film was written by Christophe Beck, and the songs were written by Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez.
Complete film screening (English with Chinese and English subtitles) with live orchestra performance. This film is classified as Category I.

event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “Mao Fujita Plays Rachmaninov” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 1 小時 45 分鐘，包括一節中場休息
event.progtimee: Approximately 1 hour 45 minutes with an intermission
event.descc:
拉赫曼尼諾夫｜ D小調第三鋼琴協奏曲，op. 30 雷史碧基｜《羅馬之泉》 雷史碧基｜《羅馬之松》
藤田真央載譽回歸，帶來拉赫曼尼諾夫激情洋溢的第三鋼琴協奏曲。指揮岡扎雷茲–蒙哈斯以活力澎湃的演出和深刻的詮釋而聞名，將呈獻雷史碧基的管弦樂交響詩，將泉水的閃耀、古松的壯麗與羅馬磅礴宏偉的景致融於樂音之中。
event.desce:
RACHMANINOV | Piano Concerto no. 3 in D minor, op. 30 RESPIGHI | Fountains of Rome RESPIGHI | Pines of Rome
After captivating audiences last season at his HK Phil debut, Mao Fujita returns with Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto no. 3 – a work celebrated for its emotional depth and technical brilliance. Joining him is conductor Roberto González-Monjas, known for his vivid musicality and insightful interpretations. Completing the programme are two of Respighi’s most evocative tone poems, depicting the shimmering fountains and majestic pines of Rome.

event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: “Standard Chartered Global Private Bank Proudly Sponsors: Tarmo Peltokoski & Lang Lang” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 2 小時，包括一節中場休息
event.descc:
沙羅倫 ︳《卡斯托》 葛利格 ︳A小調鋼琴協奏曲，op. 16 西貝遼士 ︳《藍敏凱寧組曲》，op. 22
德國《每日鏡報》盛讚貝托祺為「芬蘭指揮奇蹟」，這位港樂候任音樂總監將指揮一場洋溢北歐氣息的節目。音樂會以他的同胞兼恩師、港樂駐團作曲家沙羅倫的《卡斯托》揭開序幕，取材自希臘神話的孿生雙子，貝托祺亦將於2026年7月指揮兄弟作《波路克斯》。鋼琴巨星郎朗隨後登場，以光芒四射的舞台魅力詮釋葛利格詩意盎然、戲劇張力十足的鋼琴協奏曲。壓軸則為西貝遼士植根傳統的《藍敏凱寧組曲》，透過音樂訴說那位在芬蘭民間傳說中死而復生的驍勇戰士的神話。
event.desce:
SALONEN | Castor GRIEG | Piano Concerto in A minor, op. 16 SIBELIUS | Lemminkäinen Suite, op. 22
“The Finnish conducting miracle” – Tagesspiegel
Tarmo Peltokoski, Music Director Designate of the HK Phil, leads a captivating Nordic-inspired programme that showcases Finland in both its traditional and cosmopolitan forms. The evening opens with Castor, a dazzling orchestral work by Esa-Pekka Salonen, HK Phil’s Composer-in-Residence for the 2025/26 season and a compatriot and mentor of Peltokoski. The piece is inspired by the twin brothers of Greek mythology, Castor and Pollux. (Peltokoski will also conduct the companion piece, Pollux, in July 2026.) Superstar pianist Lang Lang then brings radiant virtuosity to Grieg’s lyrical Piano Concerto, before the concert concludes with Sibelius’s Lemminkäinen Suite, evoking the mythic heart of Finnish folklore in all its power and poetry.

event.descc:
四度演出，吸引超過11萬觀眾入場欣賞
2025年五度公演將達100場，延續香港冬日童話的歡樂
踏著夢幻舞步 漫遊香港冬日童話
港芭年度合家歡聖誕盛事《胡桃夾子》今年再度回歸，連續第五年與觀眾展開奇樂無窮的冬季歷險！衛承天以二十世紀初香港為背景改編故事，將本土文化與冒險奇想共冶一爐，炮製連連驚喜。化身王子的胡桃夾子與主角嘉麗遊歷奇幻世界，碰上多姿多彩的香港野生動植物，更與老鼠王軍團激戰連場——刀光劍影，雪花紛飛，瘋狂奇想與香港本土特色文化碰撞出連串舞台奇觀。舞服及佈景亦精美絕倫，是次演出更加入一些新元素，配合驚心動魄的劇情，看得觀眾盡興而歸！
製作於2024年先後獲頒聯合國教科文組織「卓越之星」獎及第十二屆「香港精神獎」文化貢獻獎，今年總演出場次將邁向100場，誠邀你入場一同歡慶佳節，見證這別具意義的時刻！
event.desce:
Sharing love and joy with over 110,000 guests since 2021
Celebrating this Hong Kong Adventure’s 5th Anniversary
Leap into the holiday spirit and twirl through a Hong Kong winter wonderland!
In its glorious 5th year celebrating 100 fabulous performances, Septime Webre’s heartwarming The Nutcracker: A Hong Kong Adventure with Tchaikovsky’s timeless score returns to delight audiences of all ages in an exciting Christmas Eve adventure! Clara, Fritz and the Nutcracker Prince set out to defeat the sinister Rat King to restore order to their magical kingdom, and along the way they meet Hong Kong’s vibrant peacocks, spirited racing jockeys, twirling dim sum, breathtaking bauhinias and more. Audiences will be thrilled by surprising new elements in this year’s enthralling production. With scores of glittering costumes and extraordinary sets, this enchanting classic captures the wonder of childhood and victory over evil as it celebrates early 20th century Hong Kong’s history, characters and natural beauty.
In 2024, The Nutcracker notably won UNESCO’s Star of Outstanding Award and the Spirit of Culture Award at the 12th Spirit of Hong Kong Awards.

event.titlee: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Swire Maestro Series - “Gatti Conducts Mendelssohn and Beethoven” by Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra
event.progtimec: 約 1 小時 10 分鐘，不設中場休息
event.descc:
貝多芬 ︳《艾格蒙》序曲，op. 84 孟德爾遜 ︳A大調第四交響曲，op. 90，「意大利」 貝多芬降 ︳B大調第四交響曲，op. 60
港樂與指揮大師加蒂為樂迷呈獻三首古典時期的優雅瑰寶。貝多芬將歌德悲劇由壓迫走向勝利之路濃縮於《艾格蒙》序曲。孟德爾遜遊歷期間寫下風光明媚的「意大利」交響曲，並自詡為「至今寫過最歡樂的作品」，曲中洋溢地中海的色彩——朗日晴空、莊嚴行列、宏偉建築與拿坡里薩爾塔雷洛舞曲。貝多芬第四交響曲寫於「英雄」與「命運」之間，以昂揚明亮的降B大調寫成，為這場愉悅的音樂會畫上圓滿句號。
event.desce:
BEETHOVEN | Egmont Overture, op. 84 MENDELSSOHN | Symphony no. 4 in A major, op. 90, Italian BEETHOVEN | Symphony no. 4 in B flat major, op. 60
Under Maestro Daniele Gatti’s distinguished baton, the HK Phil presents a programme of classical elegance and delight. The concert opens with Beethoven’s Egmont Overture, distilling Goethe’s tragedy into a journey from oppression to triumph. Mendelssohn’s Italian Symphony, composed during his Grand Tour and described by the composer as “the most joyful piece I have yet composed,” radiates Mediterranean colour — sunlit skies, solemn processions, majestic monuments and a Neapolitan saltarello. Beethoven’s Fourth Symphony, written between the heroic Third and the iconic Fifth, crowns the evening in uplifting B flat major.

event.descc:
是次展覽將從漫畫家的角度出發，透過不同年代與幽默港漫有關的展品，包括手稿、漫畫書、主題產品、藝術裝置及多媒體項目等，讓觀眾走進幽默港漫的世界，在幽默漫畫大道上與不同年代的漫畫人物打卡，認識漫畫家的靈感泉源，同時重溫1950年代至今的重要作品，感受幽默港漫的獨有魅力，以及其背後的創作意念和藝術特色。
聯合主辦：康樂及文化事務署、香港動漫畫聯會 聯合策劃：香港文化博物館、香港動漫畫聯會 贊助：文創產業發展處
event.desce:
Taking the perspective of comic artists, this exhibition will open the door to the magical world of comics by showcasing exhibits associated with Hong Kong comedy comics from different periods, including manuscripts, comic books, comic byproducts, art installations and multimedia programmes. Visitors can take photos with comic characters from different periods and gain insights into the inspiration of comic artists. This retrospective of important works that have amused us from the 1950s to the present will bring to life the unique charm of Hong Kong comedy comics, as well as their creative concepts and artistic features.
Jointly presented by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the Hong Kong Comics & Animation Federation
Jointly organised by the Hong Kong Heritage Museum and the Hong Kong Comics & Animation Federation
Sponsored by: Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency (CCIDA)

event.titlec: 葵青劇院場地伙伴計劃：中英劇團「第一屆香港應用劇場節」
event.titlee: Kwai Tsing Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme: "The 1ST Hong Kong Applied Theatre Festival" by Chung Ying Theatre Company
event.descc:
簡介 中英劇團積累多年應用劇場的經驗，藉劇團成立46周年，反思如何擴大應用劇場在港的影響力，適逢「禧戲劇場」已續行十年，項目圓熟，中英逐以此為契機，為項目開啟新篇章，逐有了「香港應用劇場節」的雛型。經過一年的摸索及籌備，中英將於2025年11月，主辦首屆「香港應用劇場節」。藉着連串活動，凝聚應用劇場工作者與社區人士，向大眾推廣應用劇場的不同可能。參加者除了是觀眾，也可成為項目的一部份，共同探索新的說故事方式。
好奇習作：議題劇場工作室《未來三平方》 日期及時間：28-29/11/2025 晚上8時 29-30/11/2025 下午3時 地點：葵青劇院黑盒劇場 一群來自不同背景及年齡層的人士，運用議題劇場，對「公共空間」進行資料搜集、分析及探究，把成果以意想不到的模式呈現，觀眾不再是傳統觀眾，演出不再是傳統演出，這場觀眾和表演者的對話 / 思辯，將發掘對於社區參與的更多可能性，了解自己和社區的關係。
感官敘事劇場《一刻見》 日期：27-30/11/2025 地點：葵青劇院排演室 葵青劇院的排練室將佈置為不同路線或區域，參加者透過感官互動、藝術科技和戲劇感受陌生人的真人真事，從體驗和互動中感應生命，被真誠觸動。箇中的生命故事將來自不同界別的素人，年齡背景不限，期待多元和共融。
應用戲劇研討會 日期：29/11/2025 時間：上午11時 地點：葵青劇院演講室 主題：香港應用劇場新趨勢 應用劇場是一種深度連結社區與社群的創作實踐，不只是戲劇工作者的個人構想，更需要對社區充滿好奇，願意謙卑地走進現場，傾聽、學習與共創。創作過程常涉及跨界協作，從短期訪談到長期駐點，與地區機構、專業團體及居民建立關係，理解他們的生活、想法與願景。透過口述歷史劇場、紀錄劇場、場域遊走式劇場、多元手法與社區營造等形式，戲劇工作者以自身專業梳理社群面貌，呈現香港的多元故事。本場圓桌邀請來自不同世代與背景的創作者，分享他們的社區實踐、創作觀察與跨界合作經驗，共同思考應用劇場在當代的角色與可能。
公共空間ｘ劇場遊戲《一場沒有輸贏的比賽》 日期：30/11/2025 時間：上午11時 地點：葵青劇院大堂 葵青劇院大堂將轉化為一個充滿創意能量的公共舞台，進行一場刺激又有趣的公眾活動——即興競技喜劇（Comedy Battle）。這不僅是一場演出，更是一場社群參與；或者即時創作探究公共空間。

event.titlec: 葵青劇院場地伙伴計劃：風車草劇團 — Mastercard呈獻：《偷偷記得》絮語音樂劇場
event.titlee: Kwai Tsing Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme: Mastercard Presents "Fragments of Solitude" by Wind Mill Grass Theatre
event.agelimite: Audience below 6 will not be admitted.
event.descc:
偷偷的聽著那首歌 偷偷的探訪那一個我
一間醫院嘅監護病房內，一班各式各樣生命走到盡頭嘅病人。
新入職的護士，忙碌地照顧住每一位病人，不由自主地被他們生命中的故事牽引着，想為他們盡力完成生命中未了的心願。
護士長長年累月忙碌工作，已經看透生死，成為一個冷漠的人，她不停勸告新護士，照顧病人的身體，只是一項工作。他們生命裏的遺憾，實在不能帶進自己的生命裏，結果護士長經常和新護士造成衝突。原來護士長背負着一個一生的陰影，一個自己一直逃避的陰影，更因為一個陌生人入院，潘朵拉的盒子將要揭開。
這個陌生人遇上交通意外，被送入這間病房。他對家庭、妻子和自己生命的意義，所有千絲萬縷，隨着這意外，所有都膠着了。新護士收到天使的委託，要幫助他解開所有遺憾，但最後發現原來這些和自己的人生有着一個神秘的關係⋯⋯
生命中所有曾經發生的火花，溫度，隨着生命的流逝而漸漸冷卻。如果時間可以回頭，他們又會作出什麼的選擇？
————— 編劇：梁祖堯 導演：梁祖堯、湯駿業 音樂總監：Mike Orange 主演：梁祖堯、湯駿業、邵美君、岑寧兒、胡麗英、蘇振維

event.titlec: 影畫早晨：青春印記──七公主結誼六十周年
event.titlee: Morning Matinee: Youthful Imprints: 60th Anniversary of the Seven Princesses' Sisterhood
event.progtimec: 請參閱香港電影資料館網頁。
event.progtimee: Please refer to Hong Kong Film Archive website.
event.agelimite: Persons aged under 6 will not be admitted.
event.descc:
在香港電影的黃金歲月裡，電影人之間情誼深厚，志同道合者常結為兄弟姐妹，攜手共進。無論是五十年代幕後精英組成的「七大閒」，還是六十年代當紅名伶「八牡丹」與二幫花旦「九大姐」，皆為影壇佳話。1965年，七位自童星出道、因戲結緣的年輕女星亦義結金蘭，成為家喻戶曉的「七公主」。
七公主依長幼次序分別為：大公主馮素波、二公主沈芝華、三公主陳寶珠、四公主蕭芳芳、五公主薛家燕、六公主王愛明，以及馮素波的親妹妹、七公主馮寶寶。這七位當年炙手可熱、各擅勝場的女星，不僅在銀幕上合作無間，戲外的姐妹情誼更是細水長流，不經意間已攜手走過六十載。
為誌七公主結誼六十週年，電影資料館特別以「青春印記」為主題，聚焦七公主結誼前後及年輕時期的作品，精選十五部電影，分為「結誼紀念」、「經典代表」、「青春戀曲」和「暗影芳蹤」四個單元放映。
七位公主自幼便在多部電影中以不同組合搭檔演出，但齊聚全員的戲碼，僅《七公主》一部。「結誼紀念」自當送上七位公主唯一同框的作品《七公主》（上集、大結局）；「經典代表」精選每人一部代表作，展現她們的高光時刻或個人突破，如陳寶珠首度擔任時裝片女主角的《玉女含冤》（1966）、薛家燕首次擔正的《兔女郎》（1967）等；六十年代後期，七公主中多位玉女形象鮮明，正值織夢年華，戲路一轉，主演大量描繪少女情懷與夢想的作品，「青春戀曲」為觀眾呈獻四部譜寫甜蜜或五味雜陳的愛情故事；公主們不僅能文，亦能武。陳寶珠、蕭芳芳、沈芝華師承京劇名旦粉菊花，具北派功底，「暗影芳蹤」特別挑選幾人的動作電影，她們身穿夜行衣、潛行大宅密室的俠女形象，令人難忘。
資料館特別為本節目將多部影片重新數碼化作首次放映，以更佳的聲畫質素饗影迷的期待，部分場次更特邀七公主成員及影評人出席映後談，誠邀您蒞臨這場光影盛宴，一同為七公主的友誼乾杯！
event.desce:
Hong Kong filmmakers and film workers of its golden age formed deep bonds with each other. Kindred spirits often became sworn brothers and sisters as an expression of their friendship and appreciation for each other. Such legendary alliances include ‘The Seven Idles’, a group of elite behind-the-scenes crew in the 1950s; the ‘Eight Peonies’, consisting of celebrated opera performers in the 1960s; and the opera starlets known for playing second female leads erbang huadans, who became the ‘Nine Big Sisters’. In 1965, seven young actresses—who all started out as child actors and were brought together by their shared journey in film—formed a sisterhood known as the famous ‘Seven Princesses’.
The Seven Princesses, in order of seniority, were Fung So-bor, Shum Chi-wah, Connie Chan Po-chu, Josephine Siao Fong-fong, Nancy Sit Kar-yin, Wong Oi-ming, and Fung’s younger sibling, Fung Bo-bo. Each a star in her own right, these seven actresses often collaborated onscreen, and have shared an intimate, enduring sisterly bond offscreen for six decades.
In commemoration of their 60th anniversary, the Hong Kong Film Archive presents a special programme, ‘Youthful Imprints’, spotlighting the early works of the Seven Princesses, including those made before and after their bond. Fifteen films will be screened across four categories: ‘Commemoration of Sisterhood’, ‘Signature Works’, ‘Youthful Love’, and ‘Shadows of Grace and Intrigue’.
Though the seven actresses have appeared in many films in various pairings from a young age, only one film featured all of them together: Seven Princesses. This film, along with its sequel will be screened as part of ‘Commemoration of Sisterhood’. ‘Signature Works’ features one representative film per princess, showcasing defining moments of breakthrough in their careers, such as Connie Chan’s first lead role in a contemporary drama You Do Me Wrong (1966) and Nancy Sit’s debut as leading lady in Bunny Girl (1967). In the late 1960s, as the princesses grew up into young women, they stepped into roles that captured youthful dreams and romantic longing, as befitting their maidenly images. The four films in ‘Youthful Love’ alternate between charming and bittersweet tales of love, highlighting this period in the princesses’ careers. Finally, ‘Shadows of Grace and Intrigue’ captures the princesses’ martial prowess. Connie Chan, Josephine Siao and Shum Chi-wah trained under Peking opera master Fen Ju Hua, and their Northern-style martial arts skills are on full display in the selected action films, where they deliver unforgettable performances as heroines in costumes.
The Archive has digitally scanned some selected films, which will be screened for the first time as part of this programme, offering cinephiles enhanced audio-visual quality. Select screenings will also feature post-screening talks with members of the Seven Princesses and film critics.

event.titlec: 西灣河文娛中心場地夥伴計劃：誇啦啦藝術集匯「親子藝術 FUN！」工作坊
event.titlee: Sai Wan Ho Civic Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: "Arts for Fun!" Creative Learning Family Workshop by AFTEC
event.agelimitc: 適合6歲或以上（此歲數以下恕不招待）
event.agelimite: For aged 6+ (Person below this age not admitted)
event.descc:
互動親子工作坊 玩盡四大 Art Forms 發掘你和孩子的專屬創意密碼
用藝術迸發孩子無限創意！「親子藝術 Fun！工作坊」由專業導師帶領，聯乘不同的藝術形式，發掘創意新視覺，激發親子的創意腦筋！與孩子一同迸發創意，創造屬於你們的藝術作品或片段。兩期工作坊分別以「戲劇 x 視覺藝術」、「舞蹈 x 攝影」為主題，一動一靜的藝術配搭讓小朋友大展所長，靈活發展創意思維！
戲劇 x 視覺藝術 29 & 30/11/2025 (六及日) : 導師：李誠願 & 朱卓慧
舞蹈 x 攝影 6 & 7/12/2025 (六及日) : 導師：徐茵祈 & 練錦順
適合 6 歲或以上兒童及其家長 粵語進行
event.desce:
Unleash your child's boundless creativity through the arts! Led by professional artists, the Arts for Fun family workshop bridges diverse art forms to provide fresh perspectives and stimulate creative minds! Unlock your child’s creative potential with two exciting themes, “Drama x Visual Arts” and “Dance x Photography”, and create unique artwork together!
Drama x Visual Arts 29 & 30/11/2025 (Sat & Sun) Tutors: Dominic Lee & Margaret Chu
Dance x Photography 6 & 7/12/2025 (Sat & Sun) Tutors: Liz Tsui & Thomas Lin
For children aged 6+ and their parents In Cantonese

event.presenterorge: The Absolutely Fabulous Theatre Connection

event.titlec: 西灣河文娛中心場地夥伴計劃：誇啦啦藝術集匯「創意交匯：科藝之橋 」2025
event.titlee: Sai Wan Ho Civic Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: "Vitruvian Bridge: Arts x Science Minds" 2025 by AFTEC
event.descc:
「創意交匯：科藝之橋 2025」秉承過往計劃的優良基因，為科學和藝術搭建一條互相連接的橋樑，以展覽的形式展示跨界協作的成果。本年度的「創意交匯：科藝之橋」以「想創你個腦」為主題，以藝術形式展示大腦、神經系統及情緒之間的緊密關係。展覽將邀請公眾以一個別開新面的方式去重新理解觸動你每一條「神經」的感受背後。
藝術家：姜立如、李彥錚、STICKYLINE 科學家：賴秀芸博士、林樂雯博士
event.desce:
Continuing the creative vision of DnAesthetics, What Does the Brain Say? bridges the arts and sciences. Months of conversations and exchanges culminate in an exhibition that features artworks celebrating this cross-disciplinary collaboration. Focusing on the brain, the project explores the interconnectedness of the brain, nervous system, and emotions through artistic expression. Engage your brain, nerves, and emotions in this aesthetically moving experience.
Artists: Candice Keung, Dexter Lee, STICKYLINE Scientists: Dr Cora Lai, Charlene Lam, Ph.D.

event.titlec: 西灣河文娛中心場地夥伴計劃：「創意交匯：科藝之橋」2025工作坊（公眾場）
event.titlee: Sai Wan Ho Civic Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: "Vitruvian Bridge: Arts x Science Minds" 2025 Workshop by AFTEC (For Public)
event.descc:
11月30日（日）
觀照內在：你的感受背後藏了甚麼？
面對同一件事物，為甚麼有人會感到害怕，卻有人會興奮不已？
誇啦啦邀請你透過一場以人體大腦為主題、別開生面的跨界藝術展覽，探索人類情緒感知的奧妙。透過藝術探索你的情緒，你將認識和明白自己對不同事物的反應。
藝術團隊 STICKYLINE 及註冊臨床心理學家林樂雯博士，將帶領大家一起拆解為何每個人的感受都有所不同，如何理解情緒，以及藝術如何幫助我們看清自己的內心世界。
導師：藝術團隊 STICKYLINE 及 註冊臨床心理學家林樂雯博士 -
12月7日（日）
回塗鴉期：隨心揮灑，重拾畫畫的樂趣
還記得上一次純粹為了樂趣而畫畫是甚麼時候——沒有「出界」，沒有「用錯色」，任由想像力和直覺在畫紙上自由奔馳？
誇啦啦邀請你透過一場以人體大腦為主題、別開生面的跨界藝術展覽，重拾畫畫的自由和樂趣。你將會使用獨特的繪畫工具，創作出獨一無二的畫作。
藝術家李彥錚及神經科學家賴秀芸博士將帶領你一起探索恐懼是如何形成的，以及恐懼能否通過學習消除，透過藝術拾回好奇心與創造力帶來的喜悅。
導師：藝術家李彥錚 及 神經科學家賴秀芸博士
event.desce:
30/11 (Sun)
Introspection: What Does Your Emotion Say?
Ever wondered why the same moment / object can make one person afraid and another feel excited?
Step into the cross-disciplinary exhibition with the theme of human brains, What does the Brain Say?, and explore the amazing landscape of human emotions. Explore your emotions through art, and reflect on your responses as they are revealed.
Artist duo STICKYLINE and qualified clinical psychologist Charlene Lam, Ph.D. will guide you to discover why our feelings differ, how emotions can be understood, and how the arts help us make sense of what we feel.
Facilitators: STICKYLINE, Artist duo and Charlene Lam, Ph.D., Qualified Clinical Psychologist -
7/12 (Sun)
Back to the Scribbling Stage: Reignite the Joy of Drawing
When was the last time you drew just for fun — no rules, no perfection, just your imagination running wild?
We invite you to rediscover that freedom and joy through a cross-disciplinary exhibition with the theme of human brains, What does the Brain Say?. You’ll be able to make your own expressive art piece using an unusual drawing tool.
Artist Dexter Lee and neuroscientist Dr Cora Lai will guide you to explore how fear is created and whether fear can be unlearnt, reconnecting us to curiosity and joy through the arts.
Facilitators: Dexter Lee, Artist and Dr Cora Lai, Neuroscientist

event.titlec: 石弩劇團《內幕者》
event.progtimec: 節目全長約65分鐘，不設中場休息。
event.progtimee: The running time of the performance is approximately 65 minutes without intermission.
event.agelimitc: 適合16歲或以上觀眾欣賞，6歲以下恕不招待。
event.agelimite: Recommended for ages 16 and above. Audience below 6 will not be admitted.
event.descc:
一場直擊靈魂的金融風暴
國際矚目的劇作《內幕者》靈感源自德國國家執法機構污點證人的真實案件，由國際頂尖銀行年輕稅務律師的自述展開。從初出茅廬、憑獨到的稅法解讀而嶄露頭角，到後來沉淪成為掠奪國庫的金融騙徒……直至他決定倒戈，協助警方揭露橫跨多國的龐大共犯網絡，案件涉及多家國際一線銀行，以高明手法盜取歐洲各國國庫至少五百三十億歐元，規模之大，前所未有。
event.desce: Europe’s Most Audacious Financial Crime The international success The Insider is based on the German State’s crown witness in the real international case of dividend tax fraud. It is told through a young tax lawyer in one of the world’s largest banks. You’ll join him from his starting point as an ambitious freshman with an ingenious interpretation of the tax laws, leading to a bloodbath of state-treasury-looting … At some point he decides to switch sides and help the police catch an extensive network of criminal accomplices. A network of people instrumentalising the criminal methods sucking at least 53 billion Euro out of European treasuries!
event.remarkc: 觀眾務請準時入座，遲到及中途離座者須待適當時候方可進場／返回座位。主辦機構有權拒絕遲到者進場或決定其進場的時間及方式。主辦機構有權更改節目及表演者。本節目內容不反映康樂及文化事務署的意見。

event.titlec: 荃灣大會堂場地伙伴計劃：爵士世界及起樂《荃灣有爵樂 — 櫻井哲夫 — 向JACO致敬音樂會》
event.titlee: Tsuen Wan Town Hall Venue Partnership Scheme : "JITN - Tetsuo Sakurai - Tribute to JACO" by Jazz World & Count-In Music
event.agelimitc: 適合6歲或以上人士觀看
event.descc:
在1970年代，貝斯通常扮演伴奏的角色，但天才貝斯手 Jaco Pastorius 以其卓越的彈奏技巧、創新和絃及音色開發，將貝斯演繹成音樂作品中的主角！無論是在融合爵士樂隊 Weather Reportﾠ中，還是在他個人的音樂旅程中，他的演奏都充滿感染力。雖然這位天才在 35 歲時英年早逝，但他始終被視為最偉大的貝斯手之一，銘刻在樂迷心中。
此次音樂會，日本貝斯大師櫻井哲夫將向這位美國傳奇致敬，重新演繹他的經典曲目。櫻井哲夫曾是 Casiopea 樂隊的核心，以強勁的貝斯演奏為樂隊注入活力，後來開啟獨奏生涯，足跡遍佈二十多個國家。如今，他將來到香港，用精湛的技藝致敬天才貝斯手 Jaco Pastorius。
event.desce:
In the 1970s, bass was often relegated to an accompaniment role. However, talented bassist Jaco Pastorius, with his exceptional playing technique, innovative chords, and tonal developments, transformed the instrument into a leading musical presence. Whether in his fusion jazz band Weather Report or in his personal musical journey, his playing was captivating. Although this prodigy passed away at the young age of 35, he remains etched in the hearts of music fans as one of the greatest bassists of all time.
In this concert, Japanese bass master Tetsuo Sakurai will pay tribute to this American legend by reinterpreting his classic pieces. Sakurai was a core member of the band Casiopea, infusing the group with vibrant bass performances, and later embarked on a solo career that has taken him to over twenty countries. Now, he will come to Hong Kong to honor the genius bassist Jaco Pastorius with his superb artistry.
event.presenterorgc: 爵士世界(香港)及起樂
event.presenterorge: Jazz World & Count-In Music

event.titlec: 荃灣大會堂場地伙伴計劃：爵士世界及起樂《荃灣有爵樂 — Hiromi’s Sonicwonder》
event.titlee: Tsuen Wan Town Hall Venue Partnership Scheme : "JITN-Hiromi’s Sonicwonder" by Jazz World & Count-In Music
event.agelimitc: 適合6歲或以上人士觀看
event.descc: 日本國寶級爵士鋼琴家 Hiromi，在音樂生涯中收穫了格林美獎、日本唱片大獎等諸多重量級榮譽，其演奏與創作實力早已得到業界的高度認可。由她帶領的樂隊，成員同樣實力不凡，包括兩度獲得《Downbeat》雜誌肯定的小號手 Adam O’Farrill，以及技藝精湛的法國貝斯手 Hadrien Féraud、芝加哥鼓手 Gene Coye。這支樂隊的音樂極具張力，將爵士、搖滾、電子等多種音樂元素融合在一起，形成了一種難以用常規風格來定義的獨特音樂表達。
event.desce: Hiromi, a national treasure-level jazz pianist in Japan, has won many heavyweight honors in her music career, including the Grammy Award and the Japan Record Award. Her performance and composition skills have long been highly recognized by the industry. The band she leads also has extraordinary members, including trumpeter Adam O’Farrill, who has been recognized by Downbeat magazine twice, as well as the skilled French bassist Hadrien Féraud and Chicago drummer Gene Coye. The music of this band is very tense, combining jazz, rock, electronic and other musical elements together to form a unique musical expression that is difficult to define with conventional styles.

event.titlec: 聲樂講座系列《SING聲賞識》
event.titlee: Vocal Lecture Series: The Human Voice in 4 Parts
event.progtimec: 每場講座長約1小時30分鐘。
event.progtimee: Each lecture will run for about 1 hour and 30 minutes.
event.descc:
為什麼媽媽、女僕和壞女人多是女中音？主角又多是男高音和女高音？男低音又有沒有當「男一」的機會？每個人的聲音都是那麼獨特，各自有各自的音色。
西方古典音樂傳統，大致將人聲分為女高音(soprano)、女低音(alto)、男高音(tenor)和男低音(bass)四個聲部。這也大致是以音區，籠統把歌者歸部；有人更進一步，從音色、發聲特色、平均音區、共鳴位置、音域、換聲區和劇情需要等等元素，更仔細去研究這些聲部。甚至冠以花腔、抒情、滑稽、戲劇、英雄等稱謂，令整件事變得更撲索迷離。
一連四場「SING聲賞識」講座，我會以B、A、S、T 的次序，透過多套西洋歌劇，與你們一起發掘不同聲部所演譯的不同角色。作曲家怎樣決定「某某人」適合以「某某聲」來演唱。我們更會一起認識在各聲部中，具代表性的歌者、他們的歌唱特色，並欣賞這群大師的精彩演出。
策劃／講者：陳少君
2026年1月7日（三） 第一講：男低音 (Bass)
男生唱不到高音就是男低音嗎？原來男高與男低中間還有個男中音。究竟男中音又可以再細分為高男中音及低男中音。究竟男中音和男低音又有沒有當「男一」的時刻呢？
2026年1月14日（三） 第二講：女低音 (Alto)
為什麼媽媽、女僕和女奸角多是女中音音和女低音？假聲男高音又是什麼呢？
2026年1月21日（三） 第三講：女高音 (Soprano)
為什麼女高音是常駐的「女一」？女高音一定是「好人」嗎？無論是高貴大方、楚楚可憐或霸氣十足的角色，都可以找到女高音的足跡！
2026年1月28日（三） 第四講：男高音 (Tenor)
浪漫時期意大利歌劇裡，絕大部分都是由男高音當「男一」。他們的聲音究竟有什麼魅力？他們的 High C又為何如此矜貴？
（資料由講者提供）
event.desce:
Why do the roles of mothers, maids and villainess often fall into the as mezzo-soprano range? And why are leading roles so often written for tenors and sopranos? Do basses ever get the chance to be the “leading man”? Each of us has a voice that’s uniquely our own, with its own tone, colour and personality.
In Western classical music, voices are generally divided into four categories: soprano, alto, tenor and bass. That is just a rough guide based on vocal range, but in fact, there is a lot more to it than that. Some go further, looking into tone quality, vocal colour, tessitura, resonance, and even how a role’s dramatic demands shape the choice of voice. That is why we end up with all sorts of labels like coloratura, lyric, buffo, dramatic and heroic, making the world of voices wonderfully rich and full of surprises.
In the Vocal Lecture Series: The Human Voice in 4 Parts, the speaker will lead participants on a journey through the four main voice types (in the order of B, A, S, T) to explore how each one brings a different kind of character to life on the opera stage. We will look at how composers decide which voice suits which role, and get to know some of the great singers who have become legends in their respective categories. Together, we will discover what makes their voices so distinctive and enjoy some of their unforgettable performances. Curator / Speaker: Chan Siu-kwan
7 Jan 2026 (Wed) Lecture 1: Bass Is every man who can’t hit high notes automatically a bass? Well, not quite. Between the tenor and the bass lies the baritone, and even that can be further divided into high and low baritones. We’ll find out what makes them different, and whether baritones or basses ever get to be the “leading man”.
14 Jan 2026 (Wed) Lecture 2: Alto Why do the roles of mothers, maids and villainesses so often fall into the mezzo-soprano or contralto range? And what are countertenors? They are fascinating male singers who sound almost like female altos? We’ll find out.
21 Jan 2026 (Wed) Lecture 3: Soprano Why is the soprano so often the “leading lady”? And does she always have to be the “good” one? Whether noble and elegant, tender and heartbroken, or strong and commanding — the soprano voice leaves her mark on every kind of role imaginable.
28 Jan 2026 (Wed) Lecture 4: Tenor In the great Italian operas of the Romantic era, the leading man is almost always a tenor. What makes this voice type so irresistibly charming? And why is the famous “High C” such a prized gift among tenors?
(Information provided by the speaker)
Conducted in Cantonese. Each lecture will run for about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Free seating. The programme does not represent the views of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. The presenter reserves the right to change the programme.

event.descc: 有關「終極版」:2007年《獨坐婚姻介紹所》第一部發表，並作多次重演。2021年，編劇以第一部作藍本，為當中角色寫下「另一半」的對應敘事。兩部劇情相互扣連、視角對照，雖可獨立觀賞，但同時體驗近五小時的演出後，將更能深入理解故事細節與情感。此版本為系列創作的「終極」呈現。劇情簡介︰第一部（男版）：一間標榜「百分百成功率」的婚姻介紹所，內設不容說謊的密室。三位男士接踵而至：一位與拼圖相伴半生，卻拼不出一段婚姻的中年老闆；一位熱衷「人體連結」、試圖以色欲填補「心靈斷裂」的IT人；一位利用多個博士學位，令情感「絕緣」的資優青年。當大門鎖上，一場針對內心的精密拷問隨即開始……演員：魯文傑 泰臣 劉育承協作演出：廖淑芬 鄭至芝 胡希文第二部（女版）：視角轉向三名年齡分別為 20、30、40 的女性。一位要為未出世孩子尋找父親的中年女子；一位元明碼實價卻渴望有人令她「暫停交易」的兼職情人；一位用事業成就打造完美關係的女強人。她們在拍攝自我介紹的過程中，被「聲音」不斷追問，逐步揭開隱藏多年的秘密與傷痕……演員：廖淑芬 鄭至芝 胡希文協作演出：魯文傑 泰臣 劉育承《獨坐婚姻介紹所》（終極版）為上環文娛中心場地伙伴節目之一。
